title: get all trophy
features: repost since it got bombarded with advertisements
script:
--[[
	WARNING: Heads up! This script has not been verified by ScriptBlox. Use at your own risk!
]]
local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer

local replicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local toolsFolder = replicatedStorage:WaitForChild("RegularTools")

local trophyFolder = player:WaitForChild("GetTrophy")

for _, tool in ipairs(toolsFolder:GetChildren()) do
	local toolName = tool.Name

	local value = trophyFolder:FindFirstChild(toolName)

	if not value then
		value = Instance.new("BoolValue")
		value.Name = toolName
		value.Parent = trophyFolder
	end

	if value:IsA("BoolValue") then
		value.Value = true
	end
end
